content: Yiiy sapa hôôk Kalisi-te mopaatôôv moos
+ o 4:1 Lom 6:2,7*Kalisi ninaavi hango nivaane, om ham akam oo bu yite nivaanêê-ju be ham sapa hôôk yite mopaatôôv, in omaaho sen ninaavi hango nivaanêê-to ond havuuh va nipaya la.
+ o 4:2 1; Jon 2:16*Om busin sen ham nando voon-anjo ond ham-ame sapa hôôk va sen ham anim naavi nikala in-ato le, nganjo ham oo sapa hôôk Anutu ka.

+ o 4:3 Ep 2:2-3*In bôôy ond ham doosin Anutu, ondeey ham having hil vaalu be ham nawiing va nipaya sen ham oo nawiingin-ato, om lung laa-ja. In va nipaya sen ham oo nawiing-ato nambe, ham oo nawiing baayamb danje-danjeen osin ham nawiing va nipaya vaalu sen ham alompayo navu navu in lôôt-ato, tonde ham nanum-ambe ham alumkook nawiing paya lôôt, de ham naha osin ham nanum aheta be ham nawiing va nindanjeen lôôt, tonde ham sapa hôôk anutu tatuhin vaha-sote mop anipaya.
Lemu gêên ond hil vaaluu-ju lavindis in ham-ame alukalaah having sil-ambe ham-ame nawiing va nipaya lôôt having sil yesin laah e, om sil danêêl vakasin anipaya lak ham.
+ o 4:5 Sin 10:42*Lemu sil e lambiing vakasin vu omaaho sen samu yi lung la in nambe gangoyin hil pin-ate vakasin, hil sen dando memoos osin hil sen layimb-ato silate vakasin.

+ o 4:6 Lom 8:10; 1Ko 5:5*Ondeey Kalisi la nêêl yite banye nivasa langaah vu hil sen gêên layimb lung laa-to having, in sil lako nyevahaan lukalaah silate nipaya om layimb lung la, yik nambe sen omaahonôôn pin dayimb-ato, lemu Kalisi nêêl yite banye nivasa langaah vu sil in nambe sil kanund mando metumin, yik nambe sen Anutu nando metumin-ato.
Kul sen Anutu vu vu yiiy ti ti pin-ato ond yiiy oo samu nivasa
+ o 4:7 Lom 13:11-12; 1Ko 10:11; 1Jon 2:18*Busin sen va pin navu jung naa-to ngaaho lak, om ham oo anjakin ham nivasa be ham sapa hôôk kakook anivasa mu be mem ham anohak vu Anutu.

+ o 4:8 1Pi 1:22; Jem 5:20*Tonde va sen ham ambiing keen lôôt-ato naambe ham ahem oo gaving mango-so niwêêk lôôt jak busin pin, in yahengg naving halingg-aso ond yiiy navu kawiiy silate va nipaya pin sen dawiing vu yiiy-ato la.
+ o 4:9 Hiblu 13:2*Halim-aso bel-ate lanaas balup vu ham ond ham ambaav kin in sil-ande ham-ame naanyuung e.

+ o 4:10 Lom 12:6-8*Niwêêk kul-ate sen Anutu wiing vu ham ti ti nyemalis amuu-to, ond yik ham ambiing kul jak in dôôvu mango-so, ond mem ham atu Anutu-te kul vaha-so be ham nanggin yite samu samu vaha vaha nivasa.

+ o 4:11 1Ko 10:31*Naambe omaaho ti naanêêl tanasin ond naanêêl nohvu Anutu-te vakasin, de ti nambe dôôvu hil ond yik dôôvu sil jak niwêêk sen Anutu yoo navu vu yii-to, yik va pin sen ham ambiing jak Yesu Kalisi haalêê-to ond ham ambiing nivasa be gako Anutu haale jak. Anutuu-ju yite nikaapulis bopaata lôôt-ambe yite niwêêk neep in nanjip danggata osin danggata. Keen.
Yiiy baaku nimeen ak Kalisi haale
+ o 4:12 1Pi 1:6-7*Sate va-so, ham-ame ambindis in nivaane sen natovu ham-ambe navu sahi ham-ato naambe va nindoos ti yoow e.

+ o 4:13 Sin 5:41; Lom 8:17; 2Ti 2:12; Jem 1:2*Nganjo ham akam vasa in ham nako nivaane, yik va timu nambe sen Kalisi hakôô-to, le mem dôôk busin sen yite nikaapulis naatok naam langaah-ato ond ham e kam vasa be ham naapêêlis lôôt.
+ o 4:14 Saam 89:50-51; 1Pi 2:20*Naambe hil daanêêl ham pale in Kalisi-te hil ham, ond ham akam vasa, in Anutu-te Vavi Vaambuung anikaapulis-atêêto lakando ham.
Nganjo ham ti me-nyiis omaaho ango be jimb e, de me-biing hôôndak e, tonde me-biing va nipaya le, osin me-biing me in omaaho ango-te va danjeen-ambe gako nivaane jak va nipaya nambêênjo le.
+ o 4:16 Sin 11:26; Pil 1:20*Le naambe ham ti gako nivaane in dangga nambe Kalisi-te omaaho yi, ond mem me-ninaamum e, nganjo yoo gako Anutu haale jak in wiing-ambe tu Kalisi-te omaahôô-to.

+ o 4:17 Jer 25:29; 2Tes 1:8*In busin ngaaho lak in Anutu navu bu nyevahaan dukanaah omaahonôôn-ate vakasin jakana, tombe yoo le naatovu yite hil bel-ate naamunggin. Om naambe naatovu yiiy naamunggin, ond mak hil sen laluuh damind vu Anutu-te banye nivasaa-to me-le daatovu silate nipaya nyevahaan mava?
+ o 4:18 Pro 11:31; Luk 23:31*Lohvu Anutu-te vakasin neep hôôk kaapiya nambe,

content.text: “Hil anivalok baale niwêêk-ambe baaku nimeen pin lôôt e mem Anutu gako sil naah vu yi, ond hil sen laluuh damind vu yi be dawiing va nipayaa-to le gako nipaya valok-ate.”

content: + o 4:19 Saam 31:5*Om hil sen daaku nimeen lohvu Anutu yoo nêêl lak sil anind-ato, ond yoo mondambiing va nivasa mu be lambu sil alondpayo metumin-ate dukana omaaho sen hatung va pin-ato nama, in yoo nanggin sil nivasa lôôt.
